title: The Finance Bill, 2024 (variant B)
summary: Variant B of the Finance Bill 2024 drops motor vehicle tax and VAT on bread, leaving the Affordable Housing levy deduction, eco levy, and higher money-transfer excise.

provisions.title: Affordable Housing levy deduction
provisions.summary: Treats the amount deducted under section 5(1)(a) of the Affordable Housing Act, 2024 as an allowable deduction for an employee, keeping the payroll housing levy in the tax code.
provisions.sourceExcerpt: (ad) in the case of an employee, the amount deducted in accordance with section 5(1)(a) of the Affordable Housing Act, 2024;

provisions.title: Eco levy
provisions.summary: Creates an eco levy on goods listed in a new Fourth Schedule, paid by Kenyan manufacturers when goods leave the excise stock room and by importers at entry.
provisions.sourceExcerpt: Eco levy. 7B. (1) There shall be paid a levy to be known as the eco levy on the goods specified in the Fourth Schedule manufactured in Kenya or imported into Kenya. (2) The eco levy shall be paid to the Commissioner at the rate specified in the Fourth Schedule— (a) in the case of locally manufactured goods, by the manufacturer at the time the goods are removed from the excise stock room; and (b) in the case of imported goods, by the importer at the time of entering the goods into the country.

provisions.title: Excise on money transfer and related fees
provisions.summary: Raises Part II excise rates, including fees on money transfer services, from fifteen percent to twenty percent.
